title: Kamishiro Rui — A Step Closer To My Dream〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Step Closer To My Dream（4★）

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Ah, here it is. “The Traveling Troupe”...
It's been quite a while since I last read this script.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We did this show not too long ago, but it feels nostalgic nonetheless...)
Ah, there you are.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, what are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku and the others said you were here in SEKAI, so we were wondering where.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was looking for this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's... The script for “The Traveling Troupe”?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how we ended up performing it in that dream?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That seems to have made me want to read it again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That show does mean a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I know it was just a dream, but getting to put it on together made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me as well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this show's been involved in our troupe's most critical moments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was where everything began for our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Without this show, Wonderlands×Showtime would probably never have existed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. It was also the show we used to say goodbye to the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. The Wonder Stage was so sparkly and full of smiles when we did this show that time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. That's a really nice memory...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: During that dream...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe this show helped us remember what matters most to us, including all of our memories of the past.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What matters most to us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. For example, the moments we were able to grow because we were all together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And just how precious the time we get to spend together as Wonderlands×Showtime really is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The time we get to spend together... Yeah, I think it was this show that reminded me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that sense, this show has a very special place in our hearts.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why you mentioned how this show has been involved in our troupe's most critical moments...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. So, the next time we do this show, we may find ourselves at another crossroads.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When do you think that's gonna be...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, all I can say for certain is that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The next time we perform “The Traveling Troupe”, we'll need to put on our best rendition of it yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just another reason for us to keep growing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're focused on the quality of the performance?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I agree with him. The next time we perform it, I want it to be even more fun and exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm not about to let my past self defeat me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since I am the director of Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What sorts of shows are we going to be able to do as we travel and grow as a troupe?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just the thought is making my heart dance.)
